items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I don't know him much. ... I didn't even know George Rush till I met him on here. ... I don't know much about those stuff at all.

ctx.x: So I practically take the guy's job away from him. Yeah. They overhired me right on. I don't know why.

Henry Martin. Yeah. I asked Ory last week, we saw him a week ago today, this time about, we were up there until six o'clock, and I said how come, well we were asking about something else, for a while he was going to use little Joe Lindsey on drums.
Well Joe did play with him a while.
